speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Yes, I watched one when I was a freshman — my first time at a live show.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: It was in a huge place — like a stadium, I guess, not a museum, just a really, really enormous venue.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: When I sat there, I thought, wow, this feels so unreal.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I couldn't believe I was sitting there watching my favorite singer right in front of me — well, there was still a distance, but I could actually see them.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: The vibe, the people around you, the performance — just amazing.
